profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Raytheon

positions.title: Office of Information Technology CTS Student Staff
positions.description:
- Provided hands-on troubleshooting and assistance to over 200 staff members, resolving diverse technological issues such as damaged equipment and projector malfunctions to ensure an optimal classroom learning environment
- Facilitated prompt resolution of minor technical issues over phone calls, addressing concerns related to Wi-Fi connectivity and video/audio errors, ensuring uninterrupted teaching and learning experiences.
- Conducted equipment checkouts and delivered demonstrations to staff and students, guiding them in the setup and effective utilization of rental technology

positions.title: Lab Tutor for Intro to Programming
positions.description:
- Managed a section of 40 undergraduates in Professor Shannon Alfaro's ICS31 course, guiding and facilitating their understanding of Python programming concepts
- Mentored students to enhance their problem-solving skills, providing guidance in tackling programming challenges and explaining syntax to improve their logical reasoning abilities
- Delivered comprehensive instruction on a range of topics including structured types, branching, nested loops, functions, files, and list comprehensions to ensure a well-rounded understanding of programming fundamentals

company.name: UC Irvine Donald Bren School of Information and Computer Sciences

positions.title: Youth Lead
positions.description:
- Led troop socializing and crafting activities
- Mentor younger Girl Scouts to achieve their badges and awards
- Choreograph for annual show
